Farhan Gill | farhan.gill604@example.com | +91 9162230415
Bengaluru

Professional Summary
Data-focused analyst with experience delivering business insights, dashboards, and data products across IT services and SaaS environments. Skilled in building scalable SQL pipelines, interactive Tableau and Power BI dashboards, and Python-based data processing to support product and finance stakeholders. Open to relocation anywhere in India. 60 days notice period.

Technical Skills
SQL, Python3, Tableau, Power BI, pandas, Statistics, GA4, Linux, Confluence, Agile

Work Experience

Senior Data Analyst, Tata Consultancy Services (Oct 2025 - Present)
- Developed a Tableau operational dashboard tracking utilization and project KPIs across 150+ consultants, integrating SQL-sourced datasets to reduce reporting latency from 48h to 4h; used Python to automate data quality checks.
- Built SQL data pipelines and scheduled Linux-based ETL jobs to consolidate client billing and time-entry data; implemented pandas scripts to normalize disparate schemas and improve downstream Tableau performance.
- Collaborated with product and finance teams in Agile ceremonies via Confluence, translating stakeholder requirements into Tableau visualizations and SQL queries that clarified revenue drivers.

Data Analyst, Zoho (Dec 2021 - Sep 2025)
- Designed and maintained Tableau and Power BI dashboards for product analytics, leveraging GA4 event data and SQL to surface user funnel conversion metrics that informed A/B test decisions.
- Constructed repeatable pandas workflows and Python3 scripts to process telemetry and billing logs; optimized SQL queries to reduce aggregate report runtime by 60%.
- Partnered with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment, documenting dashboards and analyses in Confluence and training stakeholders on interpretation of Statistics-backed insights.

Data Analyst, Infosys (Apr 2020 - Nov 2021)
- Implemented SQL-based ETL processes for client reporting solutions, producing standardized datasets used in Tableau and Power BI dashboards for executive stakeholders.
- Automated data validation using Python3 and pandas, identifying and resolving recurring data anomalies and improving report accuracy.
- Participated in Agile sprints and maintained analytical documentation in Confluence to support knowledge transfer and operational stability.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
